fusions.name: Ride Down
fusions.desc: Gallops you to a target up to 8 tiles away, then hits it for 14 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Drumbeat Canter
fusions.desc: Beats a rhythm around you that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one. You move 20% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Gathered Thunder
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed rises 25% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Rider's Spoils
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, your physical damage rises by 20% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
